_doc: One-time hints, shown in the corner when the game first asks for them.

welcome.text: You wake on a small island floating above the clouds. Your first goal is in the top right. What you look at and what the mouse buttons will do is written under the crosshair. H opens the handbook.

edge.text: That's the edge of the island. Below it is a very long fall. Hold Shift to sneak: sneaking, you can't walk off an edge.

grass_knife.text: By hand, tall grass just tears. Cut it with a knife and you get dry grass - tinder for fires.

firepit.text: A fire pit! Right-click more sticks onto it - each one crosses the last - and right-click dry grass to tuck tinder underneath. Then hold right-click on it with a bow drill.

firewood_needs_sticks.text: Firewood won't catch from tinder alone. Lay sticks first: tinder lights the sticks, the sticks light the firewood.

kiln.text: Raw pottery on the ground. Cover it with dry grass (right-click it) to start a pit kiln. In a pit, one block deep, it fires evenly and nothing cracks.

kiln_cover.text: Keep covering the pottery: four dry grass in all, then six sticks laid over the mound, then light it.

kiln_ready.text: The kiln is ready. Light it with the bow drill (hold right-click) or a burning torch. It takes about three hours.

kiln_open.text: This kiln is out in the open: the heat escapes on the sides, and some pieces may crack. Next time, set the pottery in a hole one block deep.

raw_pottery.text: Raw pottery is fragile and won't hold water. Fire it in a pit kiln: dig a hole, shift-right-click it in, cover it with dry grass and sticks, light it.

hungry.text: You're getting hungry. Berries, mushrooms and wild turnips will do for now; roast them on a fire and they fill you far more.

thirsty.text: You're thirsty. Hold right-click on the pond's water with an empty hand to drink.

cold.text: You're cold. Get close to a fire, or out of the wind: a roof and walls help. Rain and night make it worse.

hurt.text: You're hurt. Health comes back slowly while you're fed, watered and warm - faster asleep.

dusk.text: The sun is going down. Nights are cold here: have a fire burning, with firewood to keep it going, and somewhere sheltered to be.

rain.text: Rain. It soaks you, chills you and drowns open fires. Shelter under a roof or the overhang of the knoll.

welcome_sea.text: You wake on a small island in a wide sea. Other islands lie all around - each has things this one lacks. Your first goal is in the top right; H opens the handbook.

thirsty_sea.text: You're thirsty, and the sea is salt. Drink coconuts (break them down from under the palm fronds), or boil sea water in a pot over a fire.

rain_sea.text: Rain. It soaks you, chills you and drowns open fires. Shelter under a roof - or a sail.

raft.text: Your raft! Right-click the water beside it to lash on more sections. Make a paddle (firewood above a stick) and hold right click on board to paddle the way you look.

animal_lead.text: On the lead it follows you - onto your raft and across the sea. Right-click it again to let it go: where you let it go is its new home.
